title: CertChainError::AllTrustAnchorsExpired declared but never produced
description: error.rs declares CertChainError::AllTrustAnchorsExpired with a doc comment and Display impl, but cert.rs (the sole producer of CertChainError) never constructs this variant. The old code had a specific check for all-expired anchors; the new pkix-chain delegation maps PE::ValidityPeriod to CertChainError::CertificateExpired. Dead variant in a #[non_exhaustive] public enum adds surface area callers may match on, then never see.
